items.title: 3 Oil And Gas Stocks Facing The Next Margin Test
items.summary: Oil has swung from supply fear to talk of a glut, yet freight and war-risk costs are still biting, keeping the energy trade anything but calm. That mix of softer crude benchmarks, pricier shipping and thin inventories is reshaping where money is being made across the value chain. This piece walks through how those forces link back to integrated oil and gas producers and highlights three stocks that are currently most exposed to this story.
